intro: No MTH 201 past papers were found in the course folder. These exam-style questions were written for practice from the course outline, study guides and slides; they are not from a past paper.

papers.source: Written for this app from the MTH 201 outline, study guides and slides, because no past papers were found for the course

questions.text: a) Define the domain, codomain and range of a real-valued function, and find the domain of f(x) = √(x + 4)/(x − 1). (6 marks) b) For f(x) = x² when x < 2 and 3x − 2 when x ≥ 2, find the left- and right-hand limits at x = 2 and state whether the limit exists. (5 marks) c) Evaluate lim as x → 3 of (x² − 9)/(x − 3). (3 marks)

a) State the three conditions for f to be continuous at x = a. (3 marks) b) Show that f(x) = |x| is continuous but not differentiable at x = 0. (5 marks) c) Differentiate (i) x² sin x (ii) x/(x + 1) (iii) (3x² + 1)⁵. (6 marks)
a) Find the area bounded by y = 2x² and y = 4 − 2x. (6 marks) b) Find the volume generated when the region under y = sin x on [0, π] is rotated (i) about the x-axis (ii) about the y-axis. (8 marks)

a) Find the arc length of y = (2/3)x^(3/2) from x = 0 to x = 4. (6 marks) b) Show that the volume formed by rotating y = x³ about the y-axis between y = 1 and y = 8 is 93π/5. (5 marks) c) Define the average value of a function on [a, b]. (3 marks)

a) Find and classify the stationary points of f(x) = x³ − 6x² + 9x, and state where f is increasing and decreasing. (8 marks) b) Find the absolute maximum and minimum of f(x) = x³ − 3x on [0, 2]. (6 marks)

A trader's profit P (in naira) from selling x bags of rice is P = 120x − 2x² − 1500. (a) How many bags maximise profit? (4 marks) (b) What is the maximum profit? (3 marks) (c) For what range of x is a profit made? (5 marks) (d) Explain how the second derivative confirms your answer to (a). (2 marks)

a) State Rolle's theorem and explain why each of its conditions is needed, with a counter-example. (7 marks) b) Verify the mean value theorem for f(x) = x³ − x on [1, 3] and find c. (5 marks) c) State two consequences of the mean value theorem. (2 marks)
a) Write down the Taylor series of f(x) about x = a. (3 marks) b) Obtain the Maclaurin series of eˣ, sin x and cos x up to the term in x⁴. (8 marks) c) Use your series to estimate e^0.1. (3 marks)
a) Find and sketch the domain of f(x, y) = √(x + y + 1)/(x − 1), and evaluate f(3, 2). (6 marks) b) For f(x, y) = x³ + x²y³ − 2y², find f_x, f_y, f_xx, f_yy and f_xy. (8 marks)

a) What are level curves? Sketch the level curves of f(x, y) = 6 − 3x − 2y for k = −6, 0, 6, 12. (6 marks) b) State the chain rule for z = f(x, y) with x = x(t) and y = y(t). (3 marks) c) Use differentials to estimate the error in the volume of a cylinder V = πr²h from small errors in r and h. (5 marks)

a) Find and classify the critical points of f(x, y) = x² + y² − 2x − 6y + 14. (6 marks) b) Use Lagrange multipliers to find the maximum of f(x, y) = xy subject to x + y = 10. (5 marks) c) Evaluate ∫ from 0 to 2 ∫ from 0 to 1 of (x + y) dy dx. (3 marks)
